title: First-Order RC Low-Pass Filter (AC & Transient)
description: 1.59 kHz passive RC low-pass filter driven by a step/AC voltage source with valid DC ground path and both AC frequency sweep and transient analysis.
code:
* First-Order RC Low-Pass Filter (fc = 1.59 kHz)
V1 in 0 DC 0 AC 1 PULSE(0 5 1u 10n 10n 500u 1m)
R1 in out 1k
C1 out 0 100n
Rload out 0 100k

.AC DEC 20 10 1Meg
.TRAN 1u 2m
.END

title: Full-Wave Diode Bridge Rectifier with Smoothing Capacitor
description: 60 Hz AC mains full-wave Graetz bridge rectifier using 1N4007 silicon diodes, bulk electrolytic smoothing capacitor, and resistive DC load.
code:
* Full-Wave Diode Bridge Rectifier with Ripple Filter
Vac ac_p ac_n SIN(0 17 60)
Rref ac_n 0 100k

D1 ac_p vdc_p D1N4007
D2 ac_n vdc_p D1N4007
D3 0 ac_p D1N4007
D4 0 ac_n D1N4007

Cfilt vdc_p 0 470u
Rload vdc_p 0 100

.MODEL D1N4007 D(IS=7.02e-9 RS=0.034 N=1.80 BV=1000 IBV=5u CJO=15p)
.TRAN 100u 50m
.END

title: Common-Emitter BJT Small-Signal Amplifier
description: Voltage-divider biased 2N2222 NPN common-emitter audio amplifier with emitter degeneration and companion BJT model library.
code:
* Common-Emitter NPN BJT Small-Signal Amplifier
.include lib/bjt_models.lib

Vcc vcc 0 DC 12
Vin in 0 DC 0 AC 10m SIN(0 10m 1k)
Rs in in_s 600
Cin in_s base 10u

R1 vcc base 47k
R2 base 0 10k
Rc vcc coll 2.2k
Re emit 0 470
Ce emit 0 100u

Q1 coll base emit Q2N2222
Cout coll out 10u
Rload out 0 10k

.MODEL Q2N2222 NPN(IS=14.34f BF=255.9 VAF=74.03 IKF=0.2847 RB=10 RC=1 RE=0.5 CJE=22.01p CJC=7.306p TF=411.1p)
.OP
.AC DEC 20 10 10Meg
.TRAN 10u 5m
.END

title: 2nd-Order Sallen-Key Active Butterworth Filter
description: Unity-gain 10 kHz second-order Sallen-Key Butterworth low-pass filter using a macromodel op-amp subcircuit library.
code:
* 2nd-Order Sallen-Key Butterworth Low-Pass Filter (fc = 10 kHz)
.include lib/opamp_subckt.lib

Vin in 0 DC 0 AC 1
R1 in n1 10k
R2 n1 n2 10k
C1 n1 out 2.25n
C2 n2 0 1.12n

Xop1 n2 out out OPAMP_IDEAL
Rload out 0 10k

.SUBCKT OPAMP_IDEAL inp inm out
Rin inp inm 1Meg
Egain nint 0 inp inm 100k
Rout nint out 50
.ENDS OPAMP_IDEAL

.AC DEC 40 100 1Meg
.END

title: Synchronous Buck DC-DC Switching Converter
description: 48V-to-12V 100 kHz buck DC-DC power converter with power MOSFET model, freewheeling Schottky diode, LC output filter, and companion library files.
code:
* 48V-to-12V 100 kHz Buck DC-DC Switching Converter
.include lib/power_mosfet.lib
.include lib/pwm_ctrl.sub

Vin vin 0 DC 48
Vpwm gate_drv 0 PULSE(0 12 0 20n 20n 2.5u 10u)
Rg gate_drv gate 10

M1 vin gate sw sw NMOS_PWR
D1 0 sw D_SCHOTTKY
L1 sw vout 47u
Rl_esr vout vout_c 0.05
Cout vout_c 0 220u
Rload vout_c 0 2.4

.MODEL NMOS_PWR NMOS(LEVEL=1 VTO=3.0 KP=12.0 RD=0.04 RS=0.02 CBD=400p CBS=400p)
.MODEL D_SCHOTTKY D(IS=2e-6 RS=0.03 N=1.15 BV=60 CJO=180p)
.TRAN 50n 2m
.END
